newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's minister of communications resigns.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's minister of communications resigns.

text.p: Jordan's Minister of Communications and Postal Affairs Jamal Sarayrah has offered his resignation to Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti, a government official said on Sunday.
The official gave no reason for the resignation and did not say whether Sarayrah's offer had been accepted.
The Jordan Times newspaper quoted Sarayrah as blaming Kabariti's "haughty attitude" for his decision.
"It is the way Mr Kabariti deals with his colleagues. (This) is the worst of treatments," the paper quoted Sarayrah as saying.
Ministry officials said Sarayrah was not in his office on Sunday and declined to comment on the report.
